system.description:
Street-fighting swashbuckling — broken bottles, stolen coins, fighting dirty with style.

  • Anything Goes: Disarming Strike can target any held item (flask, key, document, pouch) not just weapons. No save if the Swashbuckler's attack roll exceeds the target's AC by 5 or more.
  • Underclass Instinct: Advantage on checks blending into underclass environments, on checks selling stolen goods, and on Deception against guards.
